results.evidence: posthog/utils.py `serve_stable_chunk_build`: after the DEBUG check and query-param check return False, `user = getattr(request, 'user', None); if user is None or not user.is_authenticated: return False` then `distinct_id = getattr(user, 'distinct_id', None)` and `return posthoganalytics.feature_enabled(STABLE_CHUNK_BUILD_FLAG, distinct_id, ..., only_evaluate_locally=True, ...) is True`. For a logged-in user with no query param, this is the only path reached, and it returns exactly the flag's boolean result (True -> stable, False -> current). There is no cookie/stored-choice mechanism anywhere in the patch, so the flag is indeed the sole automatic enrolment path.

`user = getattr(request, 'user', None); if user is None or not user.is_authenticated: return False` runs before any flag evaluation in `serve_stable_chunk_build`, so an unauthenticated request never calls `feature_enabled` and always gets `False` (current build) regardless of what the flag would have returned.

`if not distinct_id: return False` handles a missing identity; `posthoganalytics.feature_enabled(...) is True` returns False for None/false/unresolvable results; and the whole call is wrapped in `try/except Exception: logger.warning(...); return False`, so any flag-evaluation failure (not evaluated, error, empty result) falls back to `False` (current build) rather than erroring or defaulting to stable.

`_STABLE_CHUNK_BUILD_ON_VALUES = frozenset({"", "1", "true", "yes"})` and `_query_requests_stable_chunk_build` returns True only for these values; there is no recognized 'off' value. In `serve_stable_chunk_build`, `if _query_requests_stable_chunk_build(request): return True` forces the stable build for on-values (this half works), but when the param is present with an off-ish value (e.g. `stable_chunks=off`/`0`/`false`), `_query_requests_stable_chunk_build` returns False and execution falls through to the flag check, so a flag-on user would still get the stable build despite the explicit off query value — the 'off value forces current build even when flag is on' half of the criterion is not implemented.

No cookie/session-persistence code exists anywhere in the patch (no `set_cookie`, `request.COOKIES`, or similar in `posthog/utils.py` or elsewhere in the diff). `serve_stable_chunk_build` only ever inspects the current request's `request.GET` and the flag; there is no ~30-day remembered choice that would outrank the flag on subsequent requests.

`context["use_stable_chunk_build"] = use_stable_chunk_build` is only piped into `window.POSTHOG_STABLE_CHUNK_BUILD` in head.html, which is consumed solely by the chunk/CSS/script loaders to decide asset URLs. The separate pre-existing bootstrap block (`feature_flags = posthoganalytics.get_all_flags(posthog_distinct_id, only_evaluate_locally=True, person_properties=person_properties, ...)`) evaluates all flags independently, with different person_properties than `serve_stable_chunk_build`'s `person_properties={"email": user.email}`. Nothing in the diff ties the specific boolean that decided the served build to the flag value exposed to the analytics client, so whether performance events carry the same value depends on both evaluations agreeing, which the code does not guarantee or wire together explicitly.

No page-reload logic exists in the patch. The only runtime-failure handling is the JS fallback in `utils.mjs`'s `ESBUILD_LOAD_SCRIPT` and the css loader's `attempt`/`fail` retry chain, which load an alternate file path (still re-checking `window.POSTHOG_STABLE_CHUNK_BUILD` and prefixing `stable/` if still true) rather than performing a full page reload onto the current build, and there is no code to suppress a persistent opt-out or to prevent a stable retrigger on that same load.

No code in the patch modifies the visible URL/history after applying the query-parameter override (no `history.replaceState`, redirect, or URL-stripping logic anywhere in the diff); `_query_requests_stable_chunk_build` only reads `request.GET` to decide server-side behavior and never alters the address shown to the browser.

result:
The stable chunk build was only served when the page URL included the stable_chunks query parameter (1, true, yes, or an empty value). Logged-in users can now be bucketed by the feature flag frontend-stable-chunk-build, evaluated locally while rendering index.html. The flag's rollout percentage is the split: set it to 50% and about half of logged-in users get the stable build while the other half keep the current one. The exposure event is still sent, so Largest Contentful Paint on $web_vitals can be compared between the two arms.

Logged-out visitors are not enrolled. The flag is not evaluated for them, so they get no exposure and stay on the current build. The query parameter still forces the stable build for that document, including when the visitor is logged out, and that override does not evaluate the flag. A failed flag lookup serves the current build. DEBUG does not switch builds, because the dev server does not publish the parallel assets and prefixing those URLs would fail the entry module.

When the stable build is selected, the HTML sets window.POSTHOG_STABLE_CHUNK_BUILD before the loaders run. CSS and JS preload URLs are rewritten under /static/stable/. The entry script, chunk map, and stylesheet loader request that prefix. The font stays on the shared URL. The production app build copies its JS, CSS, and chunk map into frontend/dist/stable/ so those URLs resolve, and relative imports stay inside that directory.

Tests cover who is enrolled: anonymous users, the flag on and off, the query-parameter override, a logged-in user with no distinct id, and a failed flag lookup. A template-context test checks that a logged-in flag hit rewrites the CSS and JS preload URLs and leaves the font alone. Chunk-map and stylesheet loader tests check the stable URL prefix.

+/**
+ * Copy the app's JS and CSS into dist/stable/. Relative imports resolve next to the module
+ * that loaded them, so a document that opts into the stable chunk build only works when every
+ * file it requests exists under that directory. The font stays shared; asset URLs inside CSS

+function publishStableChunkBuild(outputs = {}) {
+    if (isDev) {
+        return
+    }
+    const distDir = path.resolve(__dirname, 'dist')
+    const stableDir = path.join(distDir, 'stable')
+    fs.mkdirSync(stableDir, { recursive: true })
+    const copied = new Set()
+    const copyFile = (src) => {
+        if (!src || copied.has(src) || !fs.existsSync(src)) {
+            return
+        }
+        const stat = fs.statSync(src)
+        if (!stat.isFile()) {
+            return
+        }
+        copied.add(src)
+        fs.copyFileSync(src, path.join(stableDir, path.basename(src)))
+    }
+    for (const outputPath of Object.keys(outputs)) {
+        if (!/\.(js|css)(\.map)?$/.test(outputPath)) {
+            continue
+        }
+        const absolute = path.resolve(__dirname, outputPath)
+        copyFile(absolute)
+        copyFile(`${absolute}.map`)
+    }
+    for (const name of fs.readdirSync(distDir)) {
+        if (
+            name.startsWith('chunk-map-') ||
+            name === 'index.js' ||
+            name === 'index.css' ||
+            name === 'index.js.map' ||
+            name === 'index.css.map'
+        ) {
+            copyFile(path.join(distDir, name))
+        }
+    }

+def _query_requests_stable_chunk_build(request: HttpRequest) -> bool:
+    if STABLE_CHUNK_BUILD_QUERY_PARAM not in request.GET:
+        return False
+    return request.GET.get(STABLE_CHUNK_BUILD_QUERY_PARAM, "").lower() in _STABLE_CHUNK_BUILD_ON_VALUES

+def serve_stable_chunk_build(request: HttpRequest) -> bool:
+    """Whether this HTML document should load the stable chunk build.
+
+    Logged-out visitors are not enrolled: evaluating the flag would emit an exposure for
+    a person the LCP comparison is not meant to include. The query parameter still forces
+    the build on, for someone checking it on their own page. Dev skips it because the dev
+    server does not publish the parallel ``dist/stable`` assets, and prefixing those URLs
+    would fail the entry module.
+    """
+    if settings.DEBUG:
+        return False
+    if _query_requests_stable_chunk_build(request):
+        return True
+    user = getattr(request, "user", None)
+    if user is None or not user.is_authenticated:
+        return False
+    distinct_id = getattr(user, "distinct_id", None)
+    if not distinct_id:
+        return False
+    try:
+        # Local evaluation only. A network call here would sit on every HTML response.
+        # The exposure event is what the LCP comparison joins on, so it stays enabled.
+        # Local evaluation cannot see stored person properties; pass email so a condition
+        # on it still resolves, matching the other per-document flag checks.
+        return (
+            posthoganalytics.feature_enabled(
+                STABLE_CHUNK_BUILD_FLAG,
+                distinct_id,
+                person_properties={"email": user.email} if user.email else {},
+                only_evaluate_locally=True,
+                send_feature_flag_events=True,
+            )
+            is True
+        )
+    except Exception:
+        logger.warning("stable_chunk_build_flag_check_failed_defaulting_off", exc_info=True)
+        return False
+
+
+def _stable_chunk_asset_url(url: str) -> str:
+    """Point a preload URL at the parallel stable build under ``/static/stable/``."""
+    prefix = "static/"
+    stable_prefix = "static/stable/"
+    if url.startswith(prefix) and not url.startswith(stable_prefix):
+        return stable_prefix + url[len(prefix) :]
+    return url
